description: This file defines the configuration and setup wizard for the iMessage channel within the openclaw plugin framework. It imports setup utilities, definitions for accounts, and core setup mechanisms, and exports a wizard object along with some setup adapters and parsing functions.

classes.name: ChannelSetupWizard
classes.description: Interface defining the structure for channel setup wizard objects in the plugin framework.

methods.name: createDetectedBinaryStatus
methods.description: Creates a status object indicating whether the binary for the channel is detected and configured.

methods.name: setSetupChannelEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the specified setup channel within the configuration.

methods.name: detectBinary
methods.description: Detects the presence of the binary at a given path.

methods.name: resolveIMessageAccount
methods.description: Resolves account details for a given iMessage account.

methods.name: createIMessageCliPathTextInput
methods.description: Creates a text input component for specifying the iMessage CLI path.
